from_email.description: The sender email address for change notification emails.

to_email.description: The recipient email address for change notification emails.

smtp_server.description: The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server to use for sending emails.

smtp_port.description: The port number of the SMTP server.

smtp_user.description: The username for authenticating with the SMTP server. Leave empty if no auth is required.

smtp_pass.description: The password for authenticating with the SMTP server.

feed_port.description: The port number where the mwcfeedserver listens for incoming feed requests.

watches.description: A list of websites to monitor for changes. Each entry must define a shortname and the URL to monitor.
